GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.23 (30 DEc 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1762/3)
APO 500
30 December 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Osaka-Colombo Radiotelegraph Circuit.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 311.23 (12 Aug 47)CCS, (SCAPIN 1762), dated 12 August 1947, subject as above:
2. So much of paragraphs 13, 18 and 20 of the reference memorandum pertaining to the rendering of statements of accounts on a semimonthly basis and making deposits in accordance therewith, is amended as fellows.
Effective 1 Janaury 1948, the Ministry of Communications will render statements of accounts and make deposits in accordance therewith, on a monthly basis, the period being the first to the last day of the month inclusive.
3. Direct communications within the scope of this memorandum are authorized between the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, the General Accounting Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Pavers or the British Transfer Agent and the Ministry of Communications.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
